description: Classic Marina-style home with a barrel-front facade, situated on the edge of the Sunset Rec Center. With a Full-5 floor-plan, this residence is rich in period charm and architectural detail. The living room features an arched ceiling, parquet wood floors with inlay and a wood burning fireplace. A light-filled formal dining room has coved ceilings and beveled glass doors.  The spacious eat-in kitchen includes abundant cabinetry and counter space, stainless steel appliances, and a dedicated breakfast area. Two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level. The ground floor offers a bonus room and additional full bath. The 2-car garage has laundry, storage and expansion potential. The yard features a lemon tree, concrete patio, and mature landscaping. Conveniently located just two blocks from Noriega Street shops and eateries, as well as the N-Judah Muni line. Adjacent to Sunset Rec Center, a full city block offering a playground, athletic fields, gymnasium, and more.
